title: A review of ensemble learning and data augmentation models for class imbalanced problems: combination, implementation and evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification performance using specialized metrics (F1 score and Area Under the ROC Curve) rather than standard accuracy on benchmark imbalanced datasets (e.g., Glass, Yeast, Ecoli, Abalone). This measures how effectively different combinations of data augmentation and ensemble learning methods counteract the statistical bias that machine learning models develop toward the majority class.
